FAQs

Haven’t found an answer? Go to Support

Do you have to pay for this test?

No. The test is absolutely free. You just need to enroll for the test. You will be sent details of the test date and time. You just need to login with your mobile and take the test at the assigned time.

Do I need to take the test on a computer?

Yes. This is a fully computer based test. You will need to take the full test on a computer with a working microphone. Without the microphone, you will not be able to tackle the speaking section of the test.

What if I am not able to take the test?

For you to be eligible for the prizes, you will have to complete the test at the time assigned to you. Failure to complete the test for any reason will make you ineligible for the prizes.

If you however want to attend a free session of IELTS, GRE, PTE, OET, or other courses, you can contact us and we will help you arrange a session for you.
